name: Awei T61 ENC TWS Earbuds
description:
Awei T61 ENC TWS Earbuds
The Awei T61 ENC TWS Earbuds are made for users who want high-quality music, reliable connectivity, and excellent noise suppression. These ENC earbuds (Jieli 6973D4) support Bluetooth 5.3, ensuring a smooth wireless experience with low latency and good signal stability. The Awei T61 ENC earbuds have twin ENC microphone technology that dramatically minimizes background noise, allowing for crisper calls even in loud surroundings. With a 35 mAh battery in each earbud and a 300 mAh charging case, the Awei earbuds offer up to 6 hours of playback and 5 hours of talk time, enabling continuous entertainment and conversation. The standby duration is up to 300 hours, making them excellent for long-term usage without regular charging. The Awei T61 ENC Earbuds have a charge duration of around one hour, allowing for rapid power-ups as needed. The 13mm dynamic speakers provide immersive sound with deep bass and precise highs, boosted by a sensitivity of 115±3dB at 1 KHz and an impedance of 32Ω±15% at 1 KHz. These Awei T61 wireless earbuds support a variety of Bluetooth protocols, including A2DP, AVRCP, and HFP, providing compatibility with a wide range of devices. The Awei T61 ENC Earbuds are designed for comfort and durability, featuring an ergonomic fit that allows for extended usage without discomfort. The noise reduction depth reaches 35 dB, effectively shutting out extraneous disturbances and providing a more immersive listening experience. Whether for music, gaming, or phone conversations, these Awei T61 wireless earbuds provide a dependable and high-performance option for daily usage !    6 Warranty  months (Please preserve box to claim warranty.
